## About
Ducks Roofing is a roofing contractor on Janice Dr in Kennesaw, run by owner Brandon. We work on residential and commercial roofs, from inspections and leak repairs to full replacements in shingle, tile, metal and flat roofing.
When storms, high winds or a fallen tree damage your home, we work with your claims adjuster so the repair is done right. We also take on gutters, siding, fascia and soffit, painting and other home improvement work, so one call can cover more than the roof.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 rating across 27 Google reviews. Give us a call to schedule a free estimate.

## Services
- New roofs and roof replacement: Full roof replacements for homes and commercial buildings.
- Shingle, tile, metal and flat roofs: We work with the roofing material that fits your building.
- Leak repairs: Finding and fixing the source of a leak.
- 24-hour emergency tarp and repair: Tarping and repairs to protect your home after sudden damage.
- Hail and storm damage repair: Repairs after hail, storms and high winds.
- Insurance claim assistance: We work directly with your claims adjuster on storm damage repairs.
- Roof inspection: A thorough, accurate look at the condition of your roof.
- Gutter replacement: Replacing worn or damaged gutters.
- Siding replacement: Replacing damaged or worn siding on your home.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us to schedule a free estimate.

Q: Do you offer special pricing?
A: Yes. We offer special pricing to seniors, veterans, police officers and firefighters.

Q: Do you work on commercial roofs?
A: Yes. We handle both residential and commercial roofing.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: We're open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday.
